items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did "Peggy Sue" with Buddy Holly... I played drums on his first New York recording with Buddy Holly.

ctx.x: "The Buddy Holly Story," which everybody is raving about it. But nobody knows that he was recording down south or wherever he was, but his first big record, "Peggy Sue", was recorded in New York City and Dick Jacobs
was the A&R man, and I was the drummer on that.
